name: Mars Pathfinder & Sojourner

locations.label: Carl Sagan Memorial Station, Ares Vallis

summary: Mars Pathfinder landed the first wheeled rover ever operated on Mars.
hook: I carried the microwave-sized Sojourner rover across the ancient floodplains of Ares Vallis.
how_it_worked: Used an innovative parachute, retro-rocket, and airbag bounce-landing system on the Martian surface.
science: Determined that rocks in Ares Vallis were rounded and sorted by catastrophic prehistoric water floods.

facts.text: The Sojourner microrover weighed only 10.6 kg and operated for nearly three months.
Pathfinder returned more than 16,500 images from the lander and 550 from the rover, plus more than 15 chemical analyses of rocks and soil.

image.alt: Mars Pathfinder lander on the surface of Mars
